text: 周五（9月25日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率跌3.74个基点，报5.1604%，美股盘初曾逼近2007年二季度最高位5.3228%，本周累计上涨16.44个基点，整体交投于4.9204%-5.2254%区间。 两年期美债收益率跌7.27个基点，报4.8516%，北京时间08:00跳空低开之后持续扩大跌幅，整体上持稳于9月23日顶部4.9409%（逼近2024年4月30日顶部5.0434%）附近，本周累涨10.83个基点，整体交投于4.6990%-4.9409%区间，9月21-22日低位窄幅震荡、23日显著上涨之后持续高位窄幅震荡。
text_en: In late New York trading on Friday (September 25), the benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yield fell 3.74 basis points to 5.1604%, having approached the second-quarter 2007 high of 5.3228% early in the U.S. stock session, up 16.44 basis points for the week, with overall trading in the 4.9204%-5.2254% range. The two-year U.S. Treasury yield fell 7.27 basis points to 4.8516%, continuing to expand losses after a gap lower at 08:00 Beijing time, overall holding steady near the September 23 high of 4.9409% (approaching the April 30, 2024 high of 5.0434%), up 10.83 basis points for the week, with overall trading in the 4.6990%-4.9409% range, fluctuating narrowly at lows on September 21-22 and then fluctuating narrowly at highs after a significant rise on the 23rd.
